headline: As of 2026-09-21: 7,559 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 3 of 50 states, D+47.6 registration lean.
bullets: 7,559 early/mail ballots cast so far across 3 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+47.6 by registration.
Most ballots cast: North Carolina (5,611), Pennsylvania (1,654), Florida (294).
